decisions.title: RIWI conversation destructive retention

options.A: Accept the implemented 30-day expiry and latest-60-message cap as final policy.
options.B: Keep 30 days but change the message cap; provide the exact cap.
options.C: Provide replacement expiry and cap values; implementation and tests must change.

decisions.technicalConsequence: A preserves the currently tested pruning implementation; B/C require code and boundary-test changes.
decisions.securityConsequence: Short bounded retention reduces private conversation exposure.
decisions.dataLossConsequence: Messages beyond either accepted boundary are deleted and cannot be recovered without an eligible backup.
decisions.rollbackConsequence: Changing to a longer policy cannot recover rows already pruned.
decisions.blocker: Final destructive-retention acceptance and ledger closure.

decisions.title: Speaking audio/transcript retention

options.A: Audio 30 days; reviewed/raw transcript 90 days; retain transcript-free attempt/evaluation metrics 24 months; deletion grace 7 days; orphan cleanup retry within 24 hours; legal/safety hold only when explicitly recorded.
options.B: Audio 90 days; transcript and evaluations 24 months; deletion grace 14 days; orphan cleanup retry within 24 hours; recorded legal/safety holds allowed.
options.C: Custom policy; provide audio, raw transcript, reviewed transcript, attempt/evaluation, grace, orphan retry and exception values.

decisions.technicalConsequence: Any option requires lifecycle enforcement and object/database expiry tests.
decisions.securityConsequence: A minimizes sensitive voice and transcript exposure.
decisions.dataLossConsequence: Expired audio/transcripts are intentionally irreversible after grace and backup expiry.
decisions.rollbackConsequence: A later longer policy cannot restore already-deleted private media.
decisions.blocker: Speaking privacy acceptance, Mode A/C retention reconciliation and restore policy.

decisions.title: Operational RPO/RTO target

options.A: Target RPO 15 minutes and RTO 4 hours.
options.B: Target RPO 1 hour and RTO 8 hours.
options.C: Target RPO 24 hours and RTO 24 hours.

decisions.recommended: A if the provider supports it; otherwise B
decisions.technicalConsequence: The selected target determines required PITR window, monitoring and restore procedure.
decisions.securityConsequence: More frequent recovery points reduce integrity-loss exposure after an incident.
decisions.dataLossConsequence: RPO is the maximum approved data-loss target, not a claim until provider evidence and a drill support it.
decisions.rollbackConsequence: No production setting changes are authorized by selecting a target.
decisions.blocker: Backup/PITR acceptance and contractual DR statement.

decisions.title: Object-storage migration strategy

options.A: Use O1 keep-R2 for initial cutover; also authorize an isolated-prefix O2 copy/read-back/cleanup acceptance test.
options.B: Plan O2 move-objects for cutover after isolated acceptance succeeds.
options.C: Defer storage migration and external object acceptance.

decisions.technicalConsequence: A avoids production object movement while still proving the O2 implementation safely.
decisions.securityConsequence: Both A/B require private buckets and server-side authorization; public access is forbidden.
decisions.dataLossConsequence: O2 source deletion remains forbidden until the accepted rollback window ends.
decisions.rollbackConsequence: O1 rolls back by restoring application/database configuration; O2 retains source objects for rollback.
decisions.blocker: Real O1/O2 acceptance and final cutover plan.

decisions.title: Dedicated isolated Preview authorization

options.A: Authorize deployment of this assigned branch to a disposable isolated Preview with isolated database/object prefixes and four QA roles.
options.B: Authorize deployment only; owner will provide existing isolated QA identities and resources.

decisions.technicalConsequence: A permits exact-SHA authenticated browser and provider acceptance without touching shared Preview.
decisions.securityConsequence: QA identities and resources remain isolated; secrets must be configured in the platform, never chat/Git.
decisions.dataLossConsequence: Only disposable QA data may be created or deleted.
decisions.rollbackConsequence: Remove the Preview deployment and disposable resources.
decisions.blocker: Authenticated four-role browser QA and live deployment evidence.

decisions.title: Shared Preview migration authorization

options.A: Authorize migration 0048 and any genuinely pending canonical migrations on the specifically identified shared Preview database after a verified safety point.
options.B: Authorize read-only preflight and GO/NO-GO packet only; do not apply migrations yet.

decisions.recommended: B now; A only after isolated acceptance and target identity evidence
decisions.technicalConsequence: Only A permits the shared Preview migration acceptance gate to close.
decisions.securityConsequence: Target identity, safety point and secret-safe receipts are mandatory before apply.
decisions.dataLossConsequence: Migration is additive, but any shared write operation carries operational risk.
decisions.rollbackConsequence: Use the recorded provider safety point; do not fake down-migrations.
decisions.blocker: Shared Preview migration and role smoke acceptance.

decisions.title: Backup/PITR inspection and isolated restore drill

options.A: Authorize read-only provider backup/PITR inspection and a restore into a new isolated destination; no production settings change.
options.B: Authorize receipt inspection only; defer restore.

decisions.technicalConsequence: A provides actual RPO observation, measured RTO and application integrity evidence.
decisions.securityConsequence: Restored data must use isolated private access and be deleted/quarantined per policy.
decisions.dataLossConsequence: The source is read-only; no restore over Production is allowed.
decisions.rollbackConsequence: Destroy or quarantine the isolated destination; source remains unchanged.

decisions.title: Assessment-policy workflow acceptance

options.A: Accept the current immutable 68-contract hard core and exact-hash owner overlay candidate/preview/approve/version/rollback boundaries.
options.B: Request a specific policy change; identify the exact overlay field and desired behavior.

decisions.technicalConsequence: A preserves the accepted architecture; B requires security/regression analysis and may be disallowed for hard-core fields.
decisions.securityConsequence: Hard-core rubric, answer truth, tools and Reporter paths remain immutable under A.
decisions.dataLossConsequence: Historical policy/evaluations remain version-bound and are not rewritten.
decisions.rollbackConsequence: Rollback activates a reviewed version; it never destroys history.

Configure database/provider/object-store secrets in the authorized isolated environment. Never paste secrets into chat, Git, logs or evidence artifacts.
